pr_title: Add settings to allow different SMTP envelope from address
pr_body:
Sometimes it may be advisable to hide or alias the from address on an SMTP mail
envelope. This PR adds two new options to the mailer to allow setting of an overriding
from address.

Fix #17477

Signed-off-by: Andrew Thornton <art27@cantab.net>

issue_context.title: Empty envelope sender in mail notifications
issue_context.body:
### Feature Description

Mail notifications sent by Gitea (like info about being added to repo as collaborator, checked in v1.13) have nonempty envelope sender which may generate unnecessary bounces in case of delivery problems. Now address configured in
```
[mailer]
FROM = Name <address@example.com>
```
generates messages with
```
Return-Path: <address@example.com>
From: Name <address@example.com>
```
Consider setting empty envelope sender which is allowed i.e. for bounces to avoid loops

https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc5321#section-4.1.1.2

With empty envelope sender messages should contain

```
Return-Path: <>
From: Name <address@example.com>
```

Not sure but places to be modified are:

https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/blob/main/services/mailer/mailer.go#L245
https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/blob/main/services/mailer/mailer.go#L213


### Screenshots

_No response_

review_comments:
I proposed it. Before, we need two setting options like `USE_DIFFERENT_ENVELOPE_FROM=true` `ENVELOPE_FROM=` to present an empty address.

In RFC, `<>` is the empty return path, and it doesn't cause ambiguity here. Now we can only one setting to decide:
* user wants use the default return-path: empty string (Go default value for a string)
* user wants to use an empty return-path: `<>` as RFC
* user wants to use a special return-path: `a@b.com`

If a user need to set this option, they must be very familiar with the email system, and `<>` is very clear to them.

Just remember that Go spec prefer the error strings starting with lower-case 😂 (and above)

LGTM.
